[question] Nema GFX still repeats the size calculation

The generic iterator now avoids measuring expanded text during each draw, but the Nema GFX backend routes labels through its private iterator in `src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx_label.c:433-442`, where the same `lv_text_get_size` call remains. Could that path also consume the cached size or otherwise omit the redundant measurement so this optimization applies consistently?

_P3 · confidence 0.99 · lens pass-baseline + pass-intent_
